measurementScript:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: measure.sh <syzygy-worktree> <label>
# One private daemon per capture from the worktree root; both host forms;
# the envelope fetched with the daemon's own credential file (never printed).
set -u
WT="$1"; LABEL="$2"
S=$SESSION_SCRATCHPAD
OUT="$S/m1/measure/$LABEL"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
STATE="$S/m1/state-$LABEL"; rm -rf "$STATE"; mkdir -p "$STATE"
cd "$WT"
node apps/three-surface-poc/dist/main.js --repo /home/tze/GitHub/butlers --port 0 --state-dir "$STATE" > "$OUT/daemon.log" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
for i in $(seq 1 180); do
  if grep -q 'Syzygy Three-Surface POC: http' "$OUT/daemon.log" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
  if ! kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null; then echo "daemon died"; cat "$OUT/daemon.log"; exit 1; fi
  sleep 1
done
URL=$(grep -o 'http://[^ ]*/' "$OUT/daemon.log" | head -1)
echo "daemon $URL pid=$PID"
grep -E 'Observed revision' "$OUT/daemon.log"
curl -s -o "$OUT/polaris-direct.html" -w "direct status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "${URL}polaris"
curl -s -o "$OUT/polaris-tailnet.html" -H 'Host: tzeusy.parrot-hen.ts.net' -w "tailnet status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "${URL}polaris"
TOKEN_FILE=$(find "$STATE" -name 'machine-credential.token' | head -1)
curl -s -o "$OUT/api-polaris.json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat "$TOKEN_FILE")" -w "envelope status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "${URL}api/poc/polaris"
curl -s -o "$OUT/api-poc.json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat "$TOKEN_FILE")" -w "machine status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "${URL}api/poc"
kill $PID; wait $PID 2>/dev/null
echo "syzygy=$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD) butlers=$(git -C /home/tze/GitHub/butlers rev-parse HEAD)"
